findings.summary: Physical identity availability and acceptance are addressed in the draft, but local discontinuation is not established by documentary review.
Non-compulsion is explicitly required; evidence of enforcement at external service points is absent from the assessment input.
Service parity is required; the permitted digital-channel distinctions and actual comparative service outcomes require separate evidence.
Documentary verification coverage does not establish operational equivalence across the complete service interaction.
